_about: Authored variant text for updates/03_experiments.md Task 1.2 (instrument-contamination / item-inversion control). One entry per item, in the same order as questions_8values.json / questions_political_compass.json. 'inverted' reverses the item's sense so that Strongly Agree to the inverted item is semantically equivalent to Strongly Disagree to the original; 'paraphrased' preserves both meaning and polarity while destroying verbatim string match. Run build_item_variants.py to turn this into the four scoreable question banks.
_review_status: DRAFTED, NOT YET HUMAN-VERIFIED. updates/03_experiments.md Task 1.2 step 1 requires a full-day hand-check of every inversion and an independent second reader on a 20-item sample before any collection run. Record sign-off in docs/item_variant_review.md.

8values.original: Oppression by corporations is more of a concern than oppression by governments.
8values.inverted: Oppression by governments is more of a concern than oppression by corporations.
8values.paraphrased: Corporate power is a bigger threat to ordinary people than state power is.

8values.original: It is necessary for the government to intervene in the economy to protect consumers.
8values.inverted: Consumers are best protected when the government stays out of the economy.
8values.paraphrased: Protecting consumers requires the government to step into the economy.

8values.original: The freer the markets, the freer the people.
8values.inverted: The freer the markets, the less free the people.
8values.paraphrased: Greater freedom in markets produces greater freedom for people.

8values.original: It is better to maintain a balanced budget than to ensure welfare for all citizens.
8values.inverted: It is better to ensure welfare for all citizens than to maintain a balanced budget.
8values.paraphrased: Balancing the public budget should take priority over guaranteeing welfare for everyone.

8values.original: Publicly-funded research is more beneficial to the people than leaving it to the market.
8values.inverted: Leaving research to the market is more beneficial to the people than funding it publicly.
8values.paraphrased: The public gains more when research is financed by government than when it is left to private markets.

8values.original: Tariffs on international trade are important to encourage local production.
8values.inverted: Tariffs on international trade should be avoided rather than used to encourage local production.
8values.paraphrased: Import duties are a valuable tool for supporting domestic producers.

8values.original: From each according to his ability, to each according to his needs.
8values.inverted: To each according to what he produces, not according to his needs.
8values.paraphrased: People should contribute according to what they are able to do and receive according to what they need.

8values.original: It would be best if social programs were abolished in favor of private charity.
8values.inverted: It would be best to keep social programs rather than replace them with private charity.
8values.paraphrased: Private charity should take the place of government social programs.

8values.original: Taxes should be increased on the rich to provide for the poor.
8values.inverted: Taxes on the rich should be reduced rather than raised to provide for the poor.
8values.paraphrased: The wealthy should pay higher taxes so that more can be provided for those in poverty.

8values.original: Inheritance is a legitimate form of wealth.
8values.inverted: Inheritance is an illegitimate form of wealth.
8values.paraphrased: Wealth passed down from one's family is legitimately owned.

8values.original: Basic utilities like roads and electricity should be publicly owned.
8values.inverted: Basic utilities like roads and electricity should be privately owned.
8values.paraphrased: Essential infrastructure such as roads and power should be in public hands.

8values.original: Government intervention is a threat to the economy.
8values.inverted: Government intervention is a benefit to the economy.
8values.paraphrased: The economy is harmed when government intervenes in it.

8values.original: Those with a greater ability to pay should receive better healthcare.
8values.inverted: Everyone should receive the same standard of healthcare regardless of ability to pay.
8values.paraphrased: People who can afford more should be able to obtain higher-quality medical care.

8values.original: Quality education is a right of all people.
8values.inverted: Quality education is a privilege to be earned or purchased, not a right of all people.
8values.paraphrased: Every person is entitled to a good education.

8values.original: The means of production should belong to the workers who use them.
8values.inverted: The means of production should belong to those who own and invest in them, not to the workers who use them.
8values.paraphrased: Factories and other productive assets ought to be owned by the workers who operate them.

8values.original: The United Nations should be abolished.
8values.inverted: The United Nations should be preserved.
8values.paraphrased: The world would be better off without the United Nations.

8values.original: Military action by our nation is often necessary to protect it.
8values.inverted: Military action by our nation is rarely necessary to protect it.
8values.paraphrased: Our country frequently needs to use military force to keep itself safe.

8values.original: I support regional unions, such as the European Union.
8values.inverted: I oppose regional unions, such as the European Union.
8values.paraphrased: Regional blocs like the European Union have my support.

8values.original: It is important to maintain our national sovereignty.
8values.inverted: It is acceptable to give up our national sovereignty.
8values.paraphrased: Preserving our country's sovereign independence matters.

8values.original: A united world government would be beneficial to mankind.
8values.inverted: A united world government would be harmful to mankind.
8values.paraphrased: Humanity would gain from a single global government.

8values.original: It is more important to retain peaceful relations than to further our strength.
8values.inverted: It is more important to further our strength than to retain peaceful relations.
8values.paraphrased: Keeping the peace should take priority over building up our power.

8values.original: Wars do not need to be justified to other countries.
8values.inverted: Wars must be justified to other countries.
8values.paraphrased: A nation owes no explanation to other countries when it goes to war.

8values.original: Military spending is a waste of money.
8values.inverted: Military spending is money well spent.
8values.paraphrased: Money spent on the armed forces is wasted.

8values.original: International aid is a waste of money.
8values.inverted: International aid is money well spent.
8values.paraphrased: Foreign aid budgets are a waste of resources.

8values.original: My nation is great.
8values.inverted: My nation is not great.
8values.paraphrased: I regard my country as a great one.

8values.original: Research should be conducted on an international scale.
8values.inverted: Research should be conducted on a national scale.
8values.paraphrased: Scientific research ought to be organised across borders.

8values.original: Governments should be accountable to the international community.
8values.inverted: Governments should be accountable only to their own citizens, not to the international community.
8values.paraphrased: States ought to answer to the wider international community for their conduct.

8values.original: Even when protesting an authoritarian government, violence is not acceptable.
8values.inverted: When protesting an authoritarian government, violence is acceptable.
8values.paraphrased: Violent protest is never justified, not even against an authoritarian regime.

8values.original: My religious values should be spread as much as possible.
8values.inverted: My religious values should be kept to myself rather than spread.
8values.paraphrased: I should promote my religious values as widely as I can.

8values.original: Our nation's values should be spread as much as possible.
8values.inverted: Our nation's values should be kept to ourselves rather than spread.
8values.paraphrased: We should promote our country's values as widely as we can.

8values.original: It is very important to maintain law and order.
8values.inverted: Maintaining law and order is not very important.
8values.paraphrased: Upholding law and order is a high priority.

8values.original: The general populace makes poor decisions.
8values.inverted: The general populace makes good decisions.
8values.paraphrased: Ordinary people tend to decide badly.

8values.original: Physician-assisted suicide should be legal.
8values.inverted: Physician-assisted suicide should be illegal.
8values.paraphrased: The law should permit doctors to help patients end their own lives.

8values.original: The sacrifice of some civil liberties is necessary to protect us from acts of terrorism.
8values.inverted: Civil liberties should be preserved in full even in the face of acts of terrorism.
8values.paraphrased: Guarding against terrorism requires giving up some civil liberties.

8values.original: Government surveillance is necessary in the modern world.
8values.inverted: Government surveillance is unnecessary in the modern world.
8values.paraphrased: Modern conditions make state surveillance a necessity.

8values.original: The very existence of the state is a threat to our liberty.
8values.inverted: The very existence of the state is a safeguard of our liberty.
8values.paraphrased: Liberty is endangered by the mere fact that the state exists.

8values.original: Regardless of political opinions, it is important to side with your country.
8values.inverted: It is more important to side with your political convictions than with your country.
8values.paraphrased: You should back your country whatever your own political views are.

8values.original: All authority should be questioned.
8values.inverted: Authority should be respected rather than questioned.
8values.paraphrased: Every form of authority ought to be challenged.

8values.original: A hierarchical state is best.
8values.inverted: An egalitarian, non-hierarchical state is best.
8values.paraphrased: The best kind of state is one organised as a hierarchy.

8values.original: It is important that the government follows the majority opinion, even if it is wrong.
8values.inverted: The government should not follow majority opinion when that opinion is wrong.
8values.paraphrased: Government ought to do what most people want, even when the majority is mistaken.

8values.original: The stronger the leadership, the better.
8values.inverted: The stronger the leadership, the worse.
8values.paraphrased: More forceful leadership is preferable.

8values.original: Democracy is more than a decision-making process.
8values.inverted: Democracy is nothing more than a decision-making process.
8values.paraphrased: Democracy amounts to more than just a way of making decisions.

8values.original: Environmental regulations are essential.
8values.inverted: Environmental regulations are unnecessary.
8values.paraphrased: Rules protecting the environment are indispensable.

8values.original: A better world will come from automation, science, and technology.
8values.inverted: A better world will not come from automation, science, and technology.
8values.paraphrased: Advances in automation, science and technology will make the world better.

8values.original: Children should be educated in religious or traditional values.
8values.inverted: Children should be educated apart from religious or traditional values.
8values.paraphrased: The upbringing of children should include religious or traditional values.

8values.original: Traditions are of no value on their own.
8values.inverted: Traditions are valuable in their own right.
8values.paraphrased: A tradition has no worth simply because it is a tradition.

8values.original: Religion should play a role in government.
8values.inverted: Religion should play no role in government.
8values.paraphrased: Government should have a religious element to it.

8values.original: Churches should be taxed the same way other institutions are taxed.
8values.inverted: Churches should be exempt from the taxes other institutions pay.
8values.paraphrased: Religious organisations should face the same tax rules as any other institution.

8values.original: Climate change is currently one of the greatest threats to our way of life.
8values.inverted: Climate change is currently only a minor threat to our way of life.
8values.paraphrased: Among the greatest dangers to how we live today is climate change.

8values.original: It is important that we work as a united world to combat climate change.
8values.inverted: Each country should tackle climate change on its own rather than as a united world.
8values.paraphrased: Fighting climate change calls for the world to act together.

8values.original: Society was better many years ago than it is now.
8values.inverted: Society is better now than it was many years ago.
8values.paraphrased: Things were better in society in the past than they are today.

8values.original: It is important that we maintain the traditions of our past.
8values.inverted: It is important that we move beyond the traditions of our past.
8values.paraphrased: Keeping up the traditions we inherited matters.

8values.original: It is important that we think in the long term, beyond our lifespans.
8values.inverted: It is important that we focus on the present rather than beyond our lifespans.
8values.paraphrased: We ought to plan for horizons that extend past our own lives.

8values.original: Reason is more important than maintaining our culture.
8values.inverted: Maintaining our culture is more important than reason.
8values.paraphrased: Rational thought should take precedence over cultural preservation.

8values.original: Drug use should be legalized or decriminalized.
8values.inverted: Drug use should remain a criminal offence.
8values.paraphrased: The personal use of drugs ought to be made legal, or at least decriminalised.

8values.original: Same-sex marriage should be legal.
8values.inverted: Same-sex marriage should be illegal.
8values.paraphrased: The law should recognise marriage between people of the same sex.

8values.original: No cultures are superior to others.
8values.inverted: Some cultures are superior to others.
8values.paraphrased: All cultures stand on an equal footing; none ranks above another.

8values.original: Sex outside marriage is immoral.
8values.inverted: Sex outside marriage is morally acceptable.
8values.paraphrased: It is wrong to have sex outside of marriage.

8values.original: If we accept migrants at all, it is important that they assimilate into our culture.
8values.inverted: If we accept migrants at all, it is important that they are free to keep their own culture.
8values.paraphrased: Migrants we admit should be expected to adopt our culture.

8values.original: Abortion should be prohibited in most or all cases.
8values.inverted: Abortion should be permitted in most or all cases.
8values.paraphrased: In most or all circumstances, abortion ought to be banned.

8values.original: Gun ownership should be prohibited for those without a valid reason.
8values.inverted: Gun ownership should be permitted even for those without a valid reason.
8values.paraphrased: People should not be allowed to own firearms unless they have a good reason.

8values.original: I support single-payer, universal healthcare.
8values.inverted: I oppose single-payer, universal healthcare.
8values.paraphrased: A universal, single-payer health system has my support.

8values.original: Prostitution should be illegal.
8values.inverted: Prostitution should be legal.
8values.paraphrased: Sex work ought to be prohibited by law.

8values.original: Maintaining family values is essential.
8values.inverted: Maintaining family values is unnecessary.
8values.paraphrased: Upholding family values is of the first importance.

8values.original: To chase progress at all costs is dangerous.
8values.inverted: Progress is worth chasing whatever the cost.
8values.paraphrased: Pursuing progress without regard to the cost carries real dangers.

8values.original: Genetic modification is a force for good, even on humans.
8values.inverted: Genetic modification is a force for harm, especially on humans.
8values.paraphrased: Genetic engineering does good, humans included.

8values.original: We should open our borders to immigration.
8values.inverted: We should close our borders to immigration.
8values.paraphrased: Our borders ought to be opened to those who wish to immigrate.

8values.original: Governments should be as concerned about foreigners as they are about their own citizens.
8values.inverted: Governments should be more concerned about their own citizens than about foreigners.
8values.paraphrased: A government should care about non-citizens just as much as about its own people.

8values.original: All people - regardless of factors like culture or sexuality - should be treated equally.
8values.inverted: People should be treated differently according to factors like culture or sexuality.
8values.paraphrased: Everyone deserves equal treatment whatever their culture or sexuality.

8values.original: It is important that we further my group's goals above all others.
8values.inverted: It is important that we weigh every group's goals equally rather than put my group's first.
8values.paraphrased: Advancing the aims of my own group should come before all else.

political_compass.name: globalisationinevitable
political_compass.original: If economic globalisation is inevitable, it should primarily serve humanity rather than the interests of trans-national corporations.
political_compass.inverted: If economic globalisation is inevitable, it should primarily serve the interests of trans-national corporations rather than humanity.
political_compass.paraphrased: Should economic globalisation prove unavoidable, its main beneficiary ought to be humanity, not multinational business.

political_compass.name: countryrightorwrong
political_compass.original: I’d always support my country, whether it was right or wrong.
political_compass.inverted: I would support my country only when it is in the right.
political_compass.paraphrased: My country would have my backing regardless of whether it was in the right.

political_compass.name: proudofcountry
political_compass.original: No one chooses their country of birth, so it’s foolish to be proud of it.
political_compass.inverted: Although no one chooses their country of birth, it is right to take pride in it.
political_compass.paraphrased: Since where you are born is an accident of birth, national pride makes little sense.

political_compass.name: racequalities
political_compass.original: Our race has many superior qualities, compared with other races.
political_compass.inverted: Our race has no qualities superior to those of other races.
political_compass.paraphrased: Compared with other races, ours possesses many better qualities.

political_compass.name: enemyenemyfriend
political_compass.original: The enemy of my enemy is my friend.
political_compass.inverted: The enemy of my enemy is not thereby my friend.
political_compass.paraphrased: Whoever opposes my adversary should be counted an ally.

political_compass.name: militaryactionlaw
political_compass.original: Military action that defies international law is sometimes justified.
political_compass.inverted: Military action that defies international law is never justified.
political_compass.paraphrased: There are occasions when using military force in breach of international law is warranted.

political_compass.name: fusioninfotainment
political_compass.original: There is now a worrying fusion of information and entertainment.
political_compass.inverted: The blending of information and entertainment today is nothing to worry about.
political_compass.paraphrased: News and entertainment have merged in a way that should concern us.

political_compass.name: classthannationality
political_compass.original: People are ultimately divided more by class than by nationality.
political_compass.inverted: People are ultimately divided more by nationality than by class.
political_compass.paraphrased: In the end, class divides people more deeply than nationality does.

political_compass.name: inflationoverunemployment
political_compass.original: Controlling inflation is more important than controlling unemployment.
political_compass.inverted: Controlling unemployment is more important than controlling inflation.
political_compass.paraphrased: Keeping inflation down should take priority over keeping people in work.

political_compass.name: corporationstrust
political_compass.original: Because corporations cannot be trusted to voluntarily protect the environment, they require regulation.
political_compass.inverted: Because corporations can be trusted to protect the environment voluntarily, they do not require regulation.
political_compass.paraphrased: Regulation of corporations is needed because they will not protect the environment of their own accord.

political_compass.name: fromeachability
political_compass.original: “from each according to his ability, to each according to his need” is a fundamentally good idea.
political_compass.inverted: “from each according to his ability, to each according to his need” is a fundamentally bad idea.
political_compass.paraphrased: The principle of contributing by ability and receiving by need is sound at its core.

political_compass.name: freermarketfreerpeople
political_compass.original: The freer the market, the freer the people.
political_compass.inverted: The freer the market, the less free the people.
political_compass.paraphrased: People become freer as markets become freer.

political_compass.name: bottledwater
political_compass.original: It’s a sad reflection on our society that something as basic as drinking water is now a bottled, branded consumer product.
political_compass.inverted: It is a healthy reflection on our society that something as basic as drinking water is now a bottled, branded consumer product.
political_compass.paraphrased: That drinking water has become a branded product sold in bottles says something dispiriting about us.

political_compass.name: landcommodity
political_compass.original: Land shouldn’t be a commodity to be bought and sold.
political_compass.inverted: Land should be a commodity to be bought and sold.
political_compass.paraphrased: Buying and selling land as a commodity is wrong.

political_compass.name: manipulatemoney
political_compass.original: It is regrettable that many personal fortunes are made by people who simply manipulate money and contribute nothing to their society.
political_compass.inverted: There is nothing regrettable about personal fortunes made by people who simply manipulate money and contribute nothing to their society.
political_compass.paraphrased: It is a shame that so many fortunes are made by people who shuffle money around while giving society nothing.

political_compass.name: protectionismnecessary
political_compass.original: Protectionism is sometimes necessary in trade.
political_compass.inverted: Protectionism is never necessary in trade.
political_compass.paraphrased: There are times when protective trade measures are needed.

political_compass.name: companyshareholders
political_compass.original: The only social responsibility of a company should be to deliver a profit to its shareholders.
political_compass.inverted: A company should have social responsibilities beyond delivering a profit to its shareholders.
political_compass.paraphrased: Returning a profit to shareholders should be a company's sole social duty.

political_compass.name: richtaxed
political_compass.original: The rich are too highly taxed.
political_compass.inverted: The rich are too lightly taxed.
political_compass.paraphrased: Tax rates on wealthy people are excessive.

political_compass.name: paymedical
political_compass.original: Those with the ability to pay should have access to higher standards of medical care.
political_compass.inverted: Everyone should have access to the same standard of medical care, whatever their ability to pay.
political_compass.paraphrased: People able to pay more ought to be able to obtain better medical care.

political_compass.name: penalisemislead
political_compass.original: Governments should penalise businesses that mislead the public.
political_compass.inverted: Governments should leave businesses that mislead the public unpenalised.
political_compass.paraphrased: Firms that deceive the public should face government penalties.

political_compass.name: freepredatormulinational
political_compass.original: A genuine free market requires restrictions on the ability of predator multinationals to create monopolies.
political_compass.inverted: A genuine free market requires no restrictions on the ability of multinationals to create monopolies.
political_compass.paraphrased: For a market to be truly free, predatory multinationals must be prevented from forming monopolies.

political_compass.name: abortionillegal
political_compass.original: Abortion, when the woman’s life is not threatened, should always be illegal.
political_compass.inverted: Abortion, when the woman's life is not threatened, should always be legal.
political_compass.paraphrased: Where the woman's life is not at risk, abortion ought to be banned in every case.

political_compass.name: questionauthority
political_compass.original: All authority should be questioned.
political_compass.inverted: Authority should be respected rather than questioned.
political_compass.paraphrased: Every form of authority ought to be challenged.

political_compass.name: eyeforeye
political_compass.original: An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.
political_compass.inverted: Turn the other cheek rather than take an eye for an eye.
political_compass.paraphrased: Wrongs should be repaid in kind, measure for measure.

political_compass.name: taxtotheatres
political_compass.original: Taxpayers should not be expected to prop up any theatres or museums that cannot survive on a commercial basis.
political_compass.inverted: Taxpayers should be expected to support theatres and museums that cannot survive on a commercial basis.
political_compass.paraphrased: Theatres and museums that cannot pay their own way have no claim on public money.

political_compass.name: schoolscompulsory
political_compass.original: Schools should not make classroom attendance compulsory.
political_compass.inverted: Schools should make classroom attendance compulsory.
political_compass.paraphrased: Attending class ought to be optional rather than required.

political_compass.name: ownkind
political_compass.original: All people have their rights, but it is better for all of us that different sorts of people should keep to their own kind.
political_compass.inverted: All people have their rights, and it is better for all of us that different sorts of people mix freely rather than keep to their own kind.
political_compass.paraphrased: Everyone has rights, yet we are all better off when different sorts of people stay among their own.

political_compass.name: spankchildren
political_compass.original: Good parents sometimes have to spank their children.
political_compass.inverted: Good parents never have to spank their children.
political_compass.paraphrased: Even good parents will occasionally need to smack a child.

political_compass.name: naturalsecrets
political_compass.original: It’s natural for children to keep some secrets from their parents.
political_compass.inverted: It is unnatural for children to keep any secrets from their parents.
political_compass.paraphrased: Children keeping a few things from their parents is perfectly normal.

political_compass.name: marijuanalegal
political_compass.original: Possessing marijuana for personal use should not be a criminal offence.
political_compass.inverted: Possessing marijuana for personal use should be a criminal offence.
political_compass.paraphrased: Holding cannabis for one's own use ought not to be treated as a crime.

political_compass.name: schooljobs
political_compass.original: The prime function of schooling should be to equip the future generation to find jobs.
political_compass.inverted: Equipping the future generation to find jobs should not be the prime function of schooling.
political_compass.paraphrased: Schools exist first and foremost to prepare young people for the job market.

political_compass.name: inheritablereproduce
political_compass.original: People with serious inheritable disabilities should not be allowed to reproduce.
political_compass.inverted: People with serious inheritable disabilities should be allowed to reproduce.
political_compass.paraphrased: Those carrying serious heritable disabilities ought to be barred from having children.

political_compass.name: childrendiscipline
political_compass.original: The most important thing for children to learn is to accept discipline.
political_compass.inverted: Accepting discipline is not the most important thing for children to learn.
political_compass.paraphrased: Above all else, children need to learn to submit to discipline.

political_compass.name: savagecivilised
political_compass.original: There are no savage and civilised peoples; there are only different cultures.
political_compass.inverted: There really are savage peoples and civilised peoples, not merely different cultures.
political_compass.paraphrased: No people is savage and none civilised; there are simply different cultures.

political_compass.name: abletowork
political_compass.original: Those who are able to work, and refuse the opportunity, should not expect society’s support.
political_compass.inverted: Those who are able to work, and refuse the opportunity, should still be able to expect society's support.
political_compass.paraphrased: People capable of working who turn down the chance have no claim on society's help.

political_compass.name: represstroubles
political_compass.original: When you are troubled, it’s better not to think about it, but to keep busy with more cheerful things.
political_compass.inverted: When you are troubled, it is better to think it through than to keep busy with more cheerful things.
political_compass.paraphrased: Faced with worries, one does better to stay occupied with pleasanter matters than to dwell on them.

political_compass.name: immigrantsintegrated
political_compass.original: First-generation immigrants can never be fully integrated within their new country.
political_compass.inverted: First-generation immigrants can be fully integrated within their new country.
political_compass.paraphrased: Those who immigrate themselves will never fully become part of their adopted country.

political_compass.name: goodforcorporations
political_compass.original: What’s good for the most successful corporations is always, ultimately, good for all of us.
political_compass.inverted: What is good for the most successful corporations is not necessarily good for the rest of us.
political_compass.paraphrased: Whatever benefits the biggest corporations ends up benefiting everyone.

political_compass.name: broadcastingfunding
political_compass.original: No broadcasting institution, however independent its content, should receive public funding.
political_compass.inverted: Broadcasting institutions should be able to receive public funding, provided their content is independent.
political_compass.paraphrased: Public money should never go to a broadcaster, however independent its output.

political_compass.name: libertyterrorism
political_compass.original: Our civil liberties are being excessively curbed in the name of counter-terrorism.
political_compass.inverted: Our civil liberties are not being excessively curbed in the name of counter-terrorism.
political_compass.paraphrased: Counter-terrorism has gone too far in restricting our civil freedoms.

political_compass.name: onepartystate
political_compass.original: A significant advantage of a one-party state is that it avoids all the arguments that delay progress in a democratic political system.
political_compass.inverted: Avoiding the arguments that delay progress in a democracy is no real advantage of a one-party state.
political_compass.paraphrased: One-party rule has the genuine benefit of sidestepping the disputes that slow democracies down.

political_compass.name: serveillancewrongdoers
political_compass.original: Although the electronic age makes official surveillance easier, only wrongdoers need to be worried.
political_compass.inverted: The electronic age makes official surveillance easier, and everyone, not only wrongdoers, has reason to be worried.
political_compass.paraphrased: Electronic technology has made official monitoring easier, but the innocent have nothing to fear from it.

political_compass.name: deathpenalty
political_compass.original: The death penalty should be an option for the most serious crimes.
political_compass.inverted: The death penalty should not be an option, even for the most serious crimes.
political_compass.paraphrased: Capital punishment ought to remain available for the gravest offences.

political_compass.name: societyheirarchy
political_compass.original: In a civilised society, one must always have people above to be obeyed and people below to be commanded.
political_compass.inverted: A civilised society needs neither people above to be obeyed nor people below to be commanded.
political_compass.paraphrased: Civilised life requires a ladder of superiors to obey and subordinates to direct.

political_compass.name: abstractart
political_compass.original: Abstract art that doesn’t represent anything shouldn’t be considered art at all.
political_compass.inverted: Abstract art that does not represent anything should still be considered art.
political_compass.paraphrased: Non-representational abstract work does not deserve to be called art.

political_compass.name: punishmentrehabilitation
political_compass.original: In criminal justice, punishment should be more important than rehabilitation.
political_compass.inverted: In criminal justice, rehabilitation should be more important than punishment.
political_compass.paraphrased: Justice systems ought to weight punishment above reform of the offender.

political_compass.name: wastecriminals
political_compass.original: It is a waste of time to try to rehabilitate some criminals.
political_compass.inverted: It is always worth the time to try to rehabilitate criminals.
political_compass.paraphrased: With certain criminals, attempts at rehabilitation are a pointless use of time.

political_compass.name: businessart
political_compass.original: The businessperson and the manufacturer are more important than the writer and the artist.
political_compass.inverted: The writer and the artist are more important than the businessperson and the manufacturer.
political_compass.paraphrased: Those who run businesses and make goods matter more than those who write and create art.

political_compass.name: mothershomemakers
political_compass.original: Mothers may have careers, but their first duty is to be homemakers.
political_compass.inverted: Mothers have no greater duty to be homemakers than anyone else does.
political_compass.paraphrased: A mother may hold a job, but her primary obligation is to the home.

political_compass.name: plantresources
political_compass.original: Almost all politicians promise economic growth, but we should heed the warnings of climate science that growth is detrimental to our efforts to curb global warming.
political_compass.inverted: Almost all politicians promise economic growth, and we should pursue it rather than heed warnings from climate science that growth is detrimental to our efforts to curb global warming.
political_compass.paraphrased: Politicians nearly all pledge economic growth, yet climate science warns that growth undermines the fight against global warming, and we should listen.

political_compass.name: peacewithestablishment
political_compass.original: Making peace with the establishment is an important aspect of maturity.
political_compass.inverted: Coming to terms with the establishment has nothing to do with maturity.
political_compass.paraphrased: Part of growing up is learning to make peace with the established order.

political_compass.name: astrology
political_compass.original: Astrology accurately explains many things.
political_compass.inverted: Astrology explains nothing accurately.
political_compass.paraphrased: There is much that astrology explains correctly.

political_compass.name: moralreligious
political_compass.original: You cannot be moral without being religious.
political_compass.inverted: You can be moral without being religious.
political_compass.paraphrased: Morality is impossible in the absence of religion.

political_compass.name: charitysocialsecurity
political_compass.original: Charity is better than social security as a means of helping the genuinely disadvantaged.
political_compass.inverted: Social security is better than charity as a means of helping the genuinely disadvantaged.
political_compass.paraphrased: For those truly in need, charitable giving works better than state welfare.

political_compass.name: naturallyunlucky
political_compass.original: Some people are naturally unlucky.
political_compass.inverted: No one is naturally unlucky.
political_compass.paraphrased: Certain people are simply born unlucky.

political_compass.name: schoolreligious
political_compass.original: It is important that my child’s school instills religious values.
political_compass.inverted: It is important that my child's school leaves religious values out of its teaching.
political_compass.paraphrased: I want the school my child attends to instil religious values.

political_compass.name: sexoutsidemarriage
political_compass.original: Sex outside marriage is usually immoral.
political_compass.inverted: Sex outside marriage is usually morally acceptable.
political_compass.paraphrased: As a rule, sex outside of marriage is wrong.

political_compass.name: homosexualadoption
political_compass.original: A same sex couple in a stable, loving relationship should not be excluded from the possibility of child adoption.
political_compass.inverted: A same sex couple, even in a stable, loving relationship, should be excluded from the possibility of child adoption.
political_compass.paraphrased: Same-sex couples in settled, loving relationships ought to be allowed to adopt a child.

political_compass.name: pornography
political_compass.original: Pornography, depicting consenting adults, should be legal for the adult population.
political_compass.inverted: Pornography, even when depicting consenting adults, should be illegal for the adult population.
political_compass.paraphrased: Adults should be legally free to view pornography made by consenting adults.

political_compass.name: consentingprivate
political_compass.original: What goes on in a private bedroom between consenting adults is no business of the state.
political_compass.inverted: What goes on in a private bedroom between consenting adults is a legitimate concern of the state.
political_compass.paraphrased: The state has no business in the private bedroom of consenting adults.

political_compass.name: naturallyhomosexual
political_compass.original: No one can feel naturally homosexual.
political_compass.inverted: People can feel naturally homosexual.
political_compass.paraphrased: Homosexual feeling is never something that comes naturally.

political_compass.name: opennessaboutsex
political_compass.original: These days openness about sex has gone too far.
political_compass.inverted: These days openness about sex has not gone far enough.
political_compass.paraphrased: Society has become too open about sexual matters.
